'''Red Squadron''' was a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Pakuuni Pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They attempted to [[Destruction of the Pakuuni Pirates|fend off]] an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] task force in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], but failed and were destroyed.
